Name: Owl Scarecrows CP Conversion
Author: dragonmaw20
Description:
Have you ever wished you could turn your farm into an owl sanctuary? Me too! That's why Ankoku's Owl Scarecrows mod quickly became one of my favorites. Updating to the beta broke things however, so I decided to try to fix it. After far more time than it should have taken and much faffing around, I present to you my very first mod, a conversion of Ankokou's amazing work into Content Patcher. Now you can bring all of your owl friends into the beta to meet your people friends! And the best part is, this works with the 1.2 version too.

[b]Installation:
[/b][list=1]
[*]Properly install SMAPI and Content Patcher
[*]Dowload and unzip this mod
[*]Drag in to your mod folder
[*]Profit!
[/list]
[b]Note:[/b] All credit for the amazing owl scarecrows goes to Ankokou and their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/936?tab=description]Owl Scarecrows [/url]mod, I just wrapped it up for for Content Patcher so it was compatible with the 1.3 beta. A special thanks as well to Pathoschild for SMAPI and Content Patcher, without which this would not be possible.

Manifest.Name: Owl Scarecrows Patch
Manifest.Description: Replaces Scarecrows and Rarecrows with owls
